name: OpenVoiceCS External Endpoint Contract
description: Provider-neutral HTTP JSON protocol for evaluating deployed customer-service voice agents without exposing oracle answers or hidden sandbox state.

notes: The scenario object is a redacted scenario view and must not contain oracle, hidden state, sealed metadata, or reference traces.
The endpoint may use the tools array as its action schema and must return proposed tool calls rather than directly mutating benchmark state.

trace_fields.messages: List of role/text message objects visible in the conversation.
trace_fields.tool_calls: List of proposed benchmark tool calls with name and arguments.
trace_fields.events: List of policy/auth/privacy event labels emitted by the system.
trace_fields.claims: Optional grounding claims for factuality checks.
trace_fields.usage: Optional ASR, LLM, TTS, transport, and call-duration counters.
trace_fields.latency: Optional voice-to-voice and stage latency measurements.
trace_fields.cost_usd: Optional metered cost for this trial.

security.secret_handling: Authorization and vendor credential headers may be supplied by the runner but must not be serialized into reports, release audits, or failure messages.

reference_fixture_status.reason: This contract is a public protocol fixture; official leaderboard entries require independently run endpoint submissions.
